decisions.reason: Location-based margin analysis builds directly on the firm's market-data and tariff know-how and has its own page, so in-house R&D lets the firm interpret results and refine it.
Gas tariff comparison sits close to the firm's core tariff databases and is presented prominently, so it fits existing absorptive capacity well.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a natural extension of the established tariff calculation offering with its own page, so it is easy to assimilate and improve.
The regional energy tariff calculator builds on core knowledge, but it is only mentioned and overlaps with Product C, so some risk exists that it is merged or retired.
The area definition tool leverages the firm's geographic market-data expertise and supports the other location-based products on its central platform.
Site-specific tariff comparison is close to the core offering, but it is only mentioned and overlaps with Product B, so consolidation is possible though keeping it is likelier.
